question: Which band will Rosstat's October 2026 annual CPI inflation figure fall into?

calls.reasoning: Annual Oct = 1.0635*(1+m_Oct)/1.005 - 1; band thresholds correspond to monthly m of ~1.02/1.12/1.21/1.30/1.40%. Weekly basket cumulates ~1.14% to Oct 26, ~1.20% for full month, which MinEcon's pro-rated method turns into 7.11%. But in Oct 2025 weekly showed 0.84% vs monthly 0.50% because foreign tourism (not in weekly basket) fell seasonally; MinEcon itself flagged October weekly data as unrepresentative, and 2026 reports note cheaper foreign tours / weaker lira. An analyst estimate (undated) was ~0.9-1.0% m/m, ~6.8% y/y. Centered m~1.03% with wide spread (gap uncertain; Oct 2024 gap roughly zero from memory, unverified). No human market found (harness searched Polymarket/Manifold; I did not search Kalshi or bookmakers separately).
calls.dossier:
- Rosstat weekly (pub 28 Oct 2026, Interfax/Prime): 20-26 Oct +0.08% w/w; since start of Oct +1.14%; YTD +6.24%; MinEcon annual estimate 7.11% on 26 Oct (7.15% on 19 Oct, 7.22% on 12 Oct). Pure weekly-basket y/y: 6.84% on 26 Oct (6.74% on 19 Oct) per Interfax.
- Weekly prints Oct 2026: +0.96 (29 Sep-5 Oct, utility tariff indexation 1 Oct), +0.11, +0.05, +0.08. Remaining Oct 27-31 not yet published (weekly for 27 Oct-2 Nov due 6 Nov).
- Arithmetic: annual Oct = 1.0635 x (1+m_Oct)/1.005 - 1 (Sept y/y 6.35%, Oct 2025 m/m 0.50%). Band thresholds 6.90/7.00/7.10/7.20/7.30% correspond to monthly m ~1.02/1.12/1.21/1.30/1.40%. MinEcon's 7.11% = weekly cumulative 1.14 vs pro-rated 26/31 of Oct-2025 monthly 0.50.
- Interfax (Oct 2026), citing officials: in Oct 2025 weekly data indicated +0.84% for October but the monthly CPI was +0.50% (gap -0.34pp), because foreign tourism services (absent from weekly basket) fell sharply; advice to judge October annual inflation from full-month data.
- Oct 2024: monthly 0.75%; weekly cumulative roughly similar (from memory, not verified).
- Oct 2026 news: foreign tours to some SE Asian destinations -3.1%, Black Sea rest -2.5%; Turkish lira fall reported in Oct 2026 lowering Turkey tour prices; domestic tourist services +10.7% y/y.
- finance.mail.ru article (undated, Oct 2026): October m/m expected 0.9-1.0%, annual about 6.8%.
- CBR 23 Oct 2026: key rate held at 14%, 2026 Dec/Dec forecast raised to 7.1-7.6%; analyst survey median 7.1%.
- Monthly basket is broader (incl. more services); monthly can also come in above weekly in some months.
- Resolves off Rosstat monthly October 2026 CPI release (13 Nov 2026), Oct-2026/Oct-2025 index, not weekly estimates or MinEcon y/y estimates.
- Event window: single print published 13 Nov 2026; as of 2 Nov the October price data period has ended but the monthly figure is unpublished.
- Searched for, not found: published bank analyst point estimates for the October monthly print; the Sept 2026 weekly-vs-monthly gap; any betting market (harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold).
calls.reference_class: Gap between Rosstat cumulative weekly CPI and the official monthly CPI for October (2024-2025), applied to the 2026 weekly cumulative figure

calls.reasoning: Arithmetic nowcast: Sep-2026 annual 6.35%, Oct-2025 m/m +0.50%, weekly Oct-2026 MTD +1.14% to 26 Oct plus ~0.06% for 27-31 Oct gives full-month ~1.20% and annual ~7.09%. Band edges in monthly terms: 7.00 is about 1.12%, 7.10 about 1.21%, 7.20 about 1.30%. Monthly-vs-weekly divergence historically ~0.1-0.15pp SD; September 2026 monthly beat the weekly estimate (~0.30%) and consensus (0.27%) by coming in at 0.35%, while tariff months can run either way (weekly basket may overweight utilities). Normal-ish distribution centered ~7.09-7.10 with SD ~0.13pp. No human prediction market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold checked).

- Interfax 2026-10-28: weekly CPI 20-26 Oct +0.08% (prior week +0.05%); Oct MTD +1.14%; YTD +6.24%; weekly-implied annual 7.11% as of 26 Oct (uses pro-rata daily Oct-2025 base). Earlier weekly-implied annuals: ~7.22% (12 Oct), 7.15% (19 Oct). calls.reference_class: Rosstat monthly CPI prints vs the weekly-data-implied annual rate in the final week before release (2024-2026), incl. tariff-indexation months (Jul 2024, Jul 2025)

calls.reasoning: Annual Oct = 1.0635*(1+m)/1.005 where m is the official Oct m/m. Band edges correspond to m of about 1.02 / 1.115 / 1.21 / 1.30 / 1.40%. Weekly CPI through 26 Oct gives 1.14% for October to date; adding about 0.06-0.09 for 27-31 Oct gives weekly-implied m of about 1.20-1.23% and annual of about 7.09-7.12%. The monthly figure can differ from the weekly by about ±0.2pp. In past tariff months (July 2024, July 2025, from my memory, not confirmed this run) monthly came in below weekly, which pulls the centre down slightly. September 2026 monthly was above weekly (0.35 vs about 0.30), which pulls the other way. Centre about 7.05%, SD about 0.15pp, giving a roughly normal spread over the 0.1pp bands. No prediction market found (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold searched).

- Oct 2025 monthly CPI was +0.50% m/m (base month dropping out).
- Arithmetic: annual Oct = 1.0635*(1+m_Oct)/1.005. Thresholds in m: 6.90% needs about 1.02%, 7.00% about 1.115%, 7.10% about 1.21%, 7.20% about 1.30%, 7.30% about 1.40%. 1pp of m is about 1.06pp of annual. Sept 6.35% is itself rounded (±0.005).
- Remaining days 27-31 Oct are not yet in the weekly data. The week 27 Oct-2 Nov estimate comes 6 Nov.
- Monthly vs weekly divergence history (from memory, not re-verified): in tariff-indexation months (July 2024, July 2025) the monthly CPI came in about 0.15-0.2pp below the sum of weekly prints. In many non-tariff months of 2025-26 the monthly ran 0.05-0.2pp above weekly because of services not in the weekly basket. Evidence points both ways.

calls.reference_class: Russian monthly CPI vs. cumulative weekly-CPI estimate for the same month (2024-2026), especially utility-tariff-indexation months

calls.reasoning: Annual Oct = 1.0635*(1+m)/1.005-1; band edges at m ~1.02/1.12/1.21/1.30/1.40%. Weekly data imply full-month m ~1.20% (annual ~7.1%). But October monthly CPI has come in below the weekly data in both recent years: Oct 2025 weekly 0.84 vs monthly 0.50 (foreign tourism -12.7%), Oct 2024 weekly ~0.83 vs monthly 0.75 (foreign tourism -11.9%). The seasonal drop in foreign-tour prices is not in the weekly basket. A gap of about -0.2pp gives m ~1.0% (SD ~0.15), annual ~6.88%. September 2026 monthly came in above weekly, which keeps the upper tail alive.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the arithmetic and the weekly month-to-date of 1.14%. The decisive dispute was factual: whether October monthly CPI systematically comes in below the weekly data. I checked Interfax, which confirms Oct 2025 weekly 0.84% vs monthly 0.50%, with services -0.42% and foreign tourism -12.7%. A search on Oct 2024 gave weekly prints of 0.14/0.12/0.20/0.27 (~0.83 for the full month) vs monthly 0.75%, with foreign tourism -11.9%. So the October shortfall recurs (-0.1 to -0.34pp), which backs Run 1's premise over Runs 2 and 3, who centred on the weekly figure. My market check did not run a separate search; I rely on the harness (none on Polymarket/Manifold) and the runs' reports (none on Kalshi). Final centre m ~1.0%, annual ~6.88%, SD ~0.15pp.
